text:
support: :rotating_light: Support escalation from AcmeCorp — multiple customers reporting intermittent 500s on hosted inference endpoints and some auth billing failures. SLO alert fired for 5xx-rate > 3% across prod-us-east in last 15m. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/inf/hosted-overview
support: repro steps from customer — POST to /v1/generate with X-API-Key header, same requests succeed sometimes but ~10-15% return 502/504 or 500 with body 'upstream timeout'
support: customer also saw billing error: 403 with error code BILLING_NOT_ACTIVE on retry after 500. They say their account is in good standing.
jia: ack, looking. Can someone paste the exact request payload they were using?
support: here's sanitized example:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.hosted
X-API-Key: sk-...customer
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-variants/text-3b",
  "prompt": "Summarize...",
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```

support: timestamps: failure window 2025-11-03T15:07:00Z -> 15:20:00Z

omar: starting with SLO alert panel — looks like a sharp 5xx spike at ~15:09 across edge gateways. Ingress 5xx spike correlates with a surge in connection resets from pool-host-3.

lena: checking traces. jaeger shows a bunch of requests timing out at the runtime proxy for open-variants/text-3b — many traces are missing spans between gateway -> runtime-proxy (trace gaps). tracing-bot: automated coverage report: 63% trace sampling for this service, gap detected for runtime-proxy between 15:08-15:12.

tracing-bot: trace-id examples: 7a1f... link: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace/7a1f...

omar: possible root cause: runtime-proxy overloaded due to a sudden ramp in long-seq requests. Kernel shows continuous batching queue spike. Lena, can you pull runtime-proxy logs for pool-host-3 around that time?

lena: grabbing logs. Kibana query: `service:runtime-proxy AND host:pool-host-3 AND @timestamp:[2025-11-03T15:05:00 TO 2025-11-03T15:20:00] AND level:ERROR`

lena: log snippet:
```
2025-11-03T15:09:12Z ERROR runtime-proxy batcher.cpp:278 `batch_timeout` exceeded, inflight=48, max_batch=64, kv_cache_miss=0
2025-11-03T15:09:13Z WARN runtime-proxy connection.cpp:412 upstream request failed: connection reset by peer
2025-11-03T15:09:14Z ERROR runtime-proxy scheduler.cpp:91 request dropped after retry budget exhausted
```

ashok: that matches billing error symptom — when runtime returns 500 quickly then client retries hit authz tier and our billing backend sees out-of-order states and responds 403 in rare races. We should confirm if retries are causing auth service to see expired tokens or double requests.
jia: can we reproduce locally against pool-host-3 in staging? If it's related to long-seq load, use a stress script to send concurrent long prompts.

omar: I'll run a quick k6 job hitting /v1/generate with 120 concurrent connections and payload that sets max_tokens=1024; run for 5m against canary pool. k6 script: `k6 run --vus 120 --duration 5m longseq.js`

jia: add header `X-Debug-Route: runtime-proxy` to force route to that pool. Also set `Prefer: low-latency` to mimic customer.

support: customer says this happens more often during large batches; they use SDK with auto-retry enabled (3 retries).

lena: observed error distribution: 70% 504 upstream timeout, 20% 502 connection reset, 10% 500 internal. Prometheus query I ran: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge-gateway",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (instance)` shows spike concentrated on instance edge-gw-7 and runtime pool-host-3.

omar: runtime metrics show batch queue lat p50 went from 20ms to 1.2s at 15:09 and local GPU utilization at 98%. Likely a scheduling stall. Suggest immediate mitigations: temporary circuit to route traffic away from pool-host-3 and increase runtime-proxy concurrency limits. Can we divert traffic?

ashok: applying traffic divert policy now: `rbac route set weight runtime-pool-3=0 runtime-pool-2=100 --scope prod-us-east`

slo-bot: :warning: SLO burn alert acknowledged by ashok. Alert window extended by 30m.

omar: after diversion, 5xx rate dropped to 0.4% within 90s. Good. We should confirm no residual billing 403 hits. Support, ask customer to retry now and share SDK logs.

support: customer retried one request and got 200. They will run smoke for next 30m.

jia: long-term fixes: 1) investigate batching backlog causing scheduler stall (maybe priority inversion), 2) add backpressure at gateway earlier, 3) harden retry logic in billing/auth path to be idempotent-safe and avoid transient 403 on retry races, 4) increase trace sampling for runtime-proxy to 100% for next 1h to catch gaps.

lena: I'll open runtime-proxy PR to increase sampling and add debug spans for batch handoff. Also filing an incident ticket and capturing repro steps.

ashok: after action items: patch runtime-proxy to fail-fast earlier when queue > threshold, configure autoscale to pre-spin additional instances when batch latency exceeds 500ms.

omar: putting repro script and commands in thread:
```
# curl repro
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.hosted/v1/generate \
  -H "X-API-Key: sk-test" \
  -H "X-Debug-Route: runtime-proxy" \
  -d '{"model":"open-variants/text-3b","prompt":"A long prompt...","max_tokens":1024}'
```

jia: thanks. I'll own the postmortem. tagging @lena @omar @ashok. :thumbsup:

support: I'll update customer and attach incident link when created.

tracing-bot: note: enabling 100% sampling for `runtime-proxy` between 2025-11-03T15:25:00Z and 2025-11-03T16:25:00Z.

lena: created incident INC-20251103-5xx-batcher with initial notes and links to dashboards + logs.

ashok: monitoring autoscale triggers and will follow up with proposed config in PR.

jia: good work all; keep this thread for follow-ups.
